messages:
alert-bot: [SECURITY ALERT] Unusual SSO activity: ~270 failed SSO attempts in 12m across ~40 accounts. Many requests via anonymizing exits (Tor/proxies). Several accounts hit lockout threshold.

maria: Seeing it in auth stream. X-Forwarded-For inconsistent with gateway hops for many events. MFA pushes spiking on some accounts (possible MFA fatigue attack).

ajay: Oncall assigned. First actions: block offending IP ranges at WAF, revoke sessions for targeted users, escalate to IdP for emergency ops.

leo: Can push temporary blocklist from edge. Maria, paste sample IPs? I'll correlate with CDN/proxy logs.

maria: Sample top offenders below (top 4):

```
198.51.100.12
185.220.101.23
45.77.12.9
94.130.14.160
```

maria: Query I ran on auth_events: 

```
SELECT ip, count(*) as tries, max(timestamp) as last_seen
FROM auth_events
WHERE event_type = 'sso_auth' AND outcome = 'failure' AND timestamp > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY ip
ORDER BY tries DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

nicole: Blocking those CIDRs at WAF now. Also adding a rule to drop requests with XFF/hop-count mismatch. Will deploy in ~2m.

ajay: Oncall checklist: 1) block IPs (in progress) 2) revoke active sessions for affected users 3) force password rotation where appropriate 4) open incident ticket 5) notify Trust/Security and CSMs.

leo: I have a revoke script for the IdP. Example: 

```
curl -X POST https://idp.redwood.example.com/api/v1/sessions/revoke
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IDP_ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -d '{"subject":"user@example.com","all_devices":true}'
```

maria: Also seeing many attempts with identical UA strings and failure patterns but distributed IPs. Suggest tune alerts for "MFA push flood" (>5 push attempts/user/min).

irene: I'll draft internal comms for CSMs and Legal if we need user-visible resets. No public comms yet.

nicole: Session revokes executed for 12 highest-targeted users. WAF blocks live. Dropped ~60k suspicious requests in the last 10m.

ajay: Logged containment actions in INC-2026-0412. Adding mitigation timeline and actor list.

maria: Quick sweep for successful logins from odd geos: found 3 successes. Two were revoked before observable activity. One appears to be a legitimate VPN login - validating with the user.

irene: Legal: preserve raw metadata for 365 days; do not purge until triage complete. I'll file the retention request.

nicole: Recommend enabling "challenge all high-risk SSO" (force reauth + phishing-resistant MFA) for 48h. Rollback plan required.

ajay: Enabling challenge mode now and adding rollback runbook to the incident ticket.

maria: Post-incident follow-ups: 1) alert tuning for MFA-push and proxy-chain anomalies; 2) RBAC review to restrict mass session revoke privileges; 3) fix KMS audit connector so we can map event IDs to service keys faster; 4) extend SSO audit retention to 180 days (current is 90); 5) run tabletop on MFA fatigue scenarios next week.

leo: I'll wire an IdP telemetry export to S3 and a correlation script to map session IDs to key IDs. Also proposing a detection: "proxy-chain hop-count anomaly" that flags >2 XFF hops with near-zero latency.

ajay: Any indication of account takeover beyond fatigue/lockouts? Successful sessions look limited and mostly mitigated.

maria: No clear lateral movement. We'll continue monitoring suspicious sessions and escalate if we see post-auth activity.

irene: Assigning postmortem ownership to product-security. Legal/Privacy will keep the preservation hold.

ajay: Containment complete in Slack; tracking continues in INC-2026-0412 and the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
